title: Electric Service by Rate Schedule: Availability and Entry Limits of the Seven Schedules
content:
**Rate Book — Availability.** Each Electric Service by Rate Schedule account at Cedar Fork Electric Cooperative is served on one of seven schedules. A schedule is available to a metered location only within the limits below: the service phase it accepts, the largest transformer serving the location, the band of expected maximum demand taken from the load data on the service application, and, on some schedules, the use the location must serve.

| Term | R | RS | FH | GS-1 | GS-3 | IR | LP |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Service phase accepted | Single-phase | Single-phase | Either | Single-phase | Three-phase | Either | Three-phase |
| Largest transformer serving the location (kVA) | 50 | 25 | 75 | 50 | 300 | 500 | 5000 |
| Lowest expected maximum demand (kW) | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 50 |
| Highest expected maximum demand (kW) | 50 | 25 | 75 | 50 | 50 | 400 | 2500 |
| Location must be the member's year-round primary residence | Yes | No | Yes | No | No | No | No |
| Load must serve agricultural production | No | No | Yes | No | No | Yes | No |

Column key: R is Schedule R Residential Service; RS is Schedule RS Seasonal Residential Service; FH is Schedule FH Farm and Home Service; GS-1 is Schedule GS-1 Single-Phase General Service; GS-3 is Schedule GS-3 Three-Phase General Service; IR is Schedule IR Irrigation Service; LP is Schedule LP Large Power Service.

### Intended use stated on each schedule

- **Schedule R Residential Service** — a year-round primary residence.
- **Schedule RS Seasonal Residential Service** — a cabin, lake home or other part-year residence.
- **Schedule FH Farm and Home Service** — a farm residence with farm buildings on one meter.
- **Schedule GS-1 Single-Phase General Service** — a shop, church, store, office or other non-residential load.
- **Schedule GS-3 Three-Phase General Service** — a three-phase shop, grain handling or commercial load under 50 kW.
- **Schedule IR Irrigation Service** — irrigation well and pivot pumping only.
- **Schedule LP Large Power Service** — a grain elevator, ethanol, processing or other load of 50 kW and over.

### Reading the limits

- "Either" in the phase row means the schedule accepts single-phase and three-phase service alike.
- The transformer limit is a ceiling: a transformer exactly at the listed kVA is within it, and one above it is not.
- The demand band is inclusive at both ends: an expected maximum demand of exactly 50 kW lies within the Schedule LP band (50 through 2,500 kW) and also within the Schedule R band (0 through 50 kW).
- Agricultural production means farm buildings, grain handling, livestock or irrigation pumping.

### Hypothetical illustrations

| Location (hypothetical) | Phase | Transformer | Expected demand | Within the limits of |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Lake cabin used in summer only | Single-phase | 25 kVA | 12 kW | Schedule RS (25 kVA is at its ceiling) |
| Lake cabin used in summer only | Single-phase | 37.5 kVA | 12 kW | Not Schedule RS, whose ceiling is 25 kVA |
| Three-phase bin site | Three-phase | 150 kVA | 45 kW | Schedule GS-3 (not Schedule LP, whose band starts at 50 kW) |
| Pivot well | Three-phase | 300 kVA | 260 kW | Schedule IR |
